subject: Pilot scoping: LangChain + LlamaIndex interop + tracing + prompt-tooling
messages:
From: Hector Gutiérrez <hector@llamaindex.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Aditi Rao <aditi@langchain.org>, partner@cloudbridge.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot proposal: LangChain + LlamaIndex interop with Redwood tracing

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier this week. As discussed, LlamaIndex, LangChain and PromptTools are interested in running a short pilot with Redwood to validate: 1) end-to-end interoperability for a joint SDK surface, 2) tracing propagation across SDK calls (so traces correlate across embeddings, retrieval, and generation), and 3) prompt-tooling integration for canonical prompt templates and test harnesses.

Proposed pilot at a glance:
- Duration: 6 weeks (two-week discovery + four-week implementation)
- Scope: adapter + trace shim for LangChain and LlamaIndex runtimes; sample prompt-tooling integration; perf/latency baseline vs Redwood hosted variants
- Success criteria: trace IDs persist end-to-end; sample app returns <220ms mean gen latency on 2k token mixed workload; reproducible prompts via PromptTools harness

We attached a lightweight scope doc (RI-pilot-scope-v1.pdf) and a draft SOW for your legal/devops review. Can we schedule a 30-min scoping call next week to lock stakeholders and target customer use-cases?

Thanks,
Hector
Head of Integrations — LlamaIndex

Attachment: RI-pilot-scope-v1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: hector@llamaindex.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, aditi@langchain.org, priya@prompttools.ai, partner@cloudbridge.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: LangChain + LlamaIndex interop with Redwood tracing

Hector —

Appreciate the clear proposal and the attachments. This aligns with our objectives for accelerating ISV integrations. A few quick clarifications before we lock the kickoff:

1) Discovery goals: can you share two concrete customer workflows we should prioritize (e.g., multi-stage retrieval + rerank + generation for knowledge base Q&A; retrieval-augmented summarization with citations)?
2) Trace requirements: we support distributed tracing and will need the SDKs to emit X-Redwood-Trace headers (or equivalent). Can your teams add those header hooks or would you prefer we provide a shim?
3) Data handling: any PII in the sample prompts? We have Private deployment considerations if data is sensitive.

We can do Wed 2026-12-16 11:00 PT for a 30-min scoping call — does that work for Aditi / Hector / Priya? I’ll bring Marissa for technical lead and Ben for partner ops.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): SOW-template-Redwood.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, priya@prompttools.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: LangChain + LlamaIndex interop with Redwood tracing

On Wed, Dec 16, 2026 at 11:00 Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Naomi: thanks for setting this up. Quick notes from our side following the call: 
>
> - Customer workflows: 1) Support assistant (multi-stage retrieval -> rerank -> generation -> citations); 2) Marketplace content ingestion -> retrieval + summarization pipeline.
> - Trace hooks: LangChain can emit the X-Redwood-Trace header from the Agent/Chain entry points; we’ll coordinate with LlamaIndex on the retrieval and index calls.
> - PII: we’ll use synthetic datasets for the pilot and redact any customer-provided samples.

Marissa / Ben — we propose the following owners: LangChain (Aditi) — SDK adapter + trace header patch; LlamaIndex (Hector) — retrieval adapter & index trace propagation; Redwood (Naomi + Marissa) — runtime validation, perf baselines, and deployment checklist. CloudBridge will assist on SRE/process for Dedicated footprint if needed.

Next action: each side to come back with a 1-page implementation plan by EOD Fri 2026-12-18.

— Aditi
Head of Integrations — LangChain
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: aditi@langchain.org, hector@llamaindex.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, priya@prompttools.ai, partner@cloudbridge.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: Pilot owners & tactical plan (implementation one-pagers)

Thanks all — see our one-pager summary below (attached full scope):

Marissa (technical lead) — Implementation summary (Redwood):
- Week 0–1 (Discovery): agree canonical API surface + tracing header spec; finalize test corpus (synthetic + sanitized sample); define perf harness (2k token mixed workload, concurrency 8).
- Week 2–5 (Implementation): provide language-specific shims for X-Redwood-Trace propagation; validate end-to-end trace continuity across retrieval -> embeddings -> generation; run perf buckets on Hosted vs Dedicated variants.
- Data: pilot will not use production customer PII; if customer data is required we’ll run on Private deployment.
- Deliverables: trace propagation report, perf baseline report, integration README, and a joint demo app (repo link).

Attachments: RI-pilot-scope-v1.pdf, SOW-template-Redwood.docx

Next steps: please review our timeline and owners; DocuSign SOW if ops/legal are aligned. I’ll open a JIRA (INF-2147) and invite representatives to the board.

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
